supplied_zip.note: All 15 substantive members are byte-identical (SHA-256) to 15 of the 17 files already registered under DS-000011. No new evidence; no new dataset registered.

supplied_xlsx.note: Row-for-row content matches (difflib quick_ratio >=0.92, mostly >=0.98 after stripping hyperlinks/URLs) the 63-tab '2026 Algorithm Update' Google Docs snapshot already registered as DS-000018. DS-000018 additionally contains one video (tab-47) absent from this workbook. No new dataset registered; this is a reformatted re-export of already-captured evidence.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Six AI engines can be assigned cinematic 'filmmaker persona' lenses (strengths/weaknesses/psychological mode) for collaborative script and story analysis.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: AI-collaboration workflow meta-framework only.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not treat engine 'personalities' as a platform ranking mechanism.

rules.RULE_TEXT: The 3-Step Hook Formula: Context Lean (establish a relatable frame) -> Scroll-Stop word/beat (pattern interrupt) -> Contrarian Snapback (reveal the real, counter-expectation payoff).
rules.SOURCE_LOCATOR: DOC-000002/DOC-000003 Hook (1).pdf / Hook guide.pdf (proven byte-identical pair)
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Diagnostic lens for reviewing an existing hook's structure (maps to the CONTEXT_FIRST measured hook archetype).
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not claim this guarantees retention -- retention itself is NOT_AVAILABLE in this corpus.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Intro Analyzer: judge a video's first 0-30 seconds for hook clarity, curiosity, emotional tone, and algorithmic fit.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Qualitative checklist for reviewing a hook/intro draft.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not convert 'algorithmic fit' language into a measured ranking signal.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Packaging SOP: know the target audience first; thumbnails should use bright/natural colors, bold/big fonts with fewer words, and sell one big idea; titles should be short (one sentence) and matched to broad-vs-narrow targeting.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Packaging design checklist; genuineness ('no fake attention') aligns with official satisfaction guardrail.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not treat the stated '10%+ CTR' figure as a universal target -- no fixed CTR target exists.

rules.RULE_TEXT: The same SOP claims a video's first ~10 seconds function as 'the new packaging' because YouTube autoplays, so early-video CTR-like effects matter as much as thumbnail/title.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Treat as an unverified creator hypothesis about autoplay behavior.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not present as an official platform mechanism; first-30-second retention data is NOT_AVAILABLE here.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Renae Creative Engine v2.5: a 7-engine architecture fusing cinematic storytelling, emotional psychology, and the 16 Commandments of Storytelling into one authoring system.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Meta-framework for script review; individual commandments (see TR-011-014) are the calibratable unit.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not treat as a validated retention mechanism.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Script Analyzer: judge a full script's hook, narrative spine, cinematic imagination, retention mechanics, CTA/monetization, and title/thumbnail alignment.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Maps to the measured CALCULATED_ESCALATION/CONSEQUENCE_CHAIN script archetypes as a diagnostic lens.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not infer retention from this checklist alone -- retention stays NOT_AVAILABLE.

rules.RULE_TEXT: 'Nano-Banana' prompt structure guide for AI image generation/editing: prompt structure, editing verbs, camera/lighting glossary, master prompt template.
rules.SOURCE_LOCATOR: DOC-000008 The Ultimate Nano-Banana Prompt Guide
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Thumbnail/creative asset prompting reference only.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Not a channel-strategy or algorithm rule.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Google VEO 3 prompting playbook: capabilities, prompt formulas, dialogue/audio, camera language, and JSON prompting for AI video generation.
rules.SOURCE_LOCATOR: DOC-000009 Ultimate Google VEO 3 Prompt Guide for VIRAL Videos
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: AI-video prompting reference only.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Not a channel-strategy or algorithm rule; the phrase 'for VIRAL videos' is marketing framing, not a validated outcome.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Viral Checklist item -- Audience Pain Point: name a specific pain/desire/challenge the audience already has.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Hook/title drafting checklist item.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Not independently measurable from title/hook archetype fields alone.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Viral Checklist item -- Specificity & Numbers: stats, details, or concrete numbers make a hook/title more actionable.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Directly calibratable against the measured NUMBERED_SPECIFICITY title archetype and NUMBER_LED hook archetype.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not generalize a single channel's positive result to all channels -- see cross-channel evidence.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Viral Checklist item -- Contrarian Thinking: an idea that challenges conventional wisdom.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Maps to the measured COUNTERINTUITIVE_PREMISE hook archetype, which is corpus-wide too sparse (1-2 items/channel) to calibrate -- see the CH-000001 single-item 281x ratio counter-example.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not promote the single extreme CH-000001 counterintuitive-premise ratio into a general rule -- one item is not a repeatable pattern.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Title Analyzer: opens with creator notes on title psychology and 7 viral title formulas, framed against YouTube's 'Viewer Satisfaction' signal language, before AI-persona title-rewrite prompts.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Title-drafting checklist; the 7 formulas map loosely onto measured title archetypes (QUESTION, NUMBERED_SPECIFICITY, WARNING_OR_RISK, ...).
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not treat 'Viewer Satisfaction' language here as equivalent to the official Appeal/Engagement/Satisfaction framework without independent confirmation.

rules.RULE_TEXT: 16 Commandments of Storytelling: script quality judged across story arc, promise alignment, narrative spine, retention engineering, and cinematic energy.
rules.SOURCE_LOCATOR: DOC-000017 Seven Engine Storytelling Analysis Prompts (16 Commandments Integrated)
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: 'Promise alignment' commandment maps directly to the HOOK_PROMISE_MATCH root-cause layer already used in unified plan coherence checks.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not treat commandment adherence as a guaranteed retention driver -- retention is NOT_AVAILABLE.

rules.RULE_TEXT: 'BUT/THEREFORE' causal storytelling: chain scenes and script beats with 'but' (complication) and 'therefore' (consequence) instead of flat 'and then' sequencing.
rules.SOURCE_LOCATOR: DOC-000015 The Magic of 'BUT' and 'THEREFORE' in Storytelling
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Maps to the measured CONSEQUENCE_CHAIN script archetype (causal escalation) as a diagnostic lens.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not claim causal-chain scripting causes higher retention -- retention is NOT_AVAILABLE; only views-per-day association is measured.

rules.RULE_TEXT: YouTube Video SEO checklist: phase-by-phase keyword research, script/video-quality optimization, title/description/tag optimization, and thumbnail SEO.
rules.SOURCE_LOCATOR: DOC-000016 YouTube Video SEO - COMPLETE CHECKLIST DOCUMENT
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Publishing/metadata checklist.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not treat keyword-density claims as a confirmed ranking mechanism.

rules.RULE_TEXT: 'YouTube Intelligence Brain v1' operating system: unifies research, ideation, packaging, scripting, retention engineering, SEO, and publishing for a senior-health/doctor-led channel around an explicit truth-hierarchy and evidence-labeling discipline (this repository's own evidence-layer vocabulary traces to this document).
rules.SOURCE_LOCATOR: DOC-000013 YouTube Intelligence Brain v1.0 - Verified Creator Operating System
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Directly relevant meta-framework for the CH-000003/CH-000005 senior-health/health niche diagnosis and blueprint.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not treat as validated platform mechanism; it is a creator operating-system template.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Recommendations are selected per-viewer at surface load time, using viewer history and current context to rank candidates for that viewer.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: General personalization framing.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not infer a specific ranking formula from this.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Early subscriber response is not one global verdict; the system can learn different responses for subscribers, non-subscribers, and new viewers.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Bounded hypothesis only.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not assume an exact three-cohort training architecture.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Initial performance is not the sole basis for later recommendations; evergreen videos may receive most views well after publication.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Supports LONGITUDINAL_TREND=NOT_AVAILABLE discipline (later discovery is possible but not measured here).
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not claim a majority-of-lifetime-views outcome as measured.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Long-term viewer value is the broad ranking objective; ranking uses multiple context-dependent signals rather than one universal metric or fixed weight.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Grounds the 'no single success score' system rule.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not collapse into one score.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Channels should align with audiences; recommendations may still distinguish topic, length, Shorts/long-form/podcast/live-stream preferences within one channel.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Bounded hypothesis; conflicts with CLM-018.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not treat mixing formats on one channel as risk-free.

rules.RULE_TEXT: A suggested video need not share the current video's topic; personalization can connect cross-topic videos through a viewer's broader interests.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: General framing only.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: No exact cross-topic matcher mechanism is established.

rules.RULE_TEXT: New channels/fresh videos can be matched to viewers without prior channel-viewer history, using topical preferences and subject understanding.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Supports new-channel blueprint cold-start framing.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: No exact first-upload audience-assignment mechanism is established.

rules.RULE_TEXT: A subscription does not imply interest in every upload; the system seeks the interested subset rather than relying on aggregate subscriber click behavior.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Subscribers are not a guaranteed audience.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: No numerical subscriber-CTR gate is validated.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Literal near-identical templated repetition may be treated as spam, while a reusable format with genuinely differing episodes can remain acceptable.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Supports 'repeatable format' vs 'templated spam' distinction in family health labeling.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not infer a specific ranking penalty.

rules.RULE_TEXT: A subscription-feed recommendation shelf can select from subscribed channels using recent interests while a chronological feed remains available below it.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Bounded context only.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not assume universal rollout.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Watch history is an important recommendation input because it indicates viewer interests.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: General framing.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: No universal cross-surface weight is asserted.

rules.RULE_TEXT: A translated creator transcript claims YouTube uses a large recommender model and semantic IDs derived from metadata, frames, audio, pacing, and format.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Only the audiovisual-embedding portion has primary support.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not assert the full metadata/pacing/format bundle as confirmed.

rules.RULE_TEXT: The same transcript claims semantic IDs connect to watch-history clusters representing recent formats, styles, interests, and mood.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Do not use as a working assumption.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Private mood-cluster linkage is not publicly verifiable.

rules.RULE_TEXT: A strategist reports TV viewing rising from ~23-24% to over 50% of selected clients' viewing.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Do not use as a working assumption.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Self-reported client sample lacks underlying data.

rules.RULE_TEXT: A strategist reports mean/median long-form duration increased 51% since 2020 across a 100-billion-view analysis.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Do not use as a working assumption.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: No universal ideal-length rule follows even if true.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Experiments with larger, fewer homepage thumbnails allegedly improved selection/long-form viewing while smaller/new-channel recommendations stayed near the top.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Do not use as a working assumption.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: No direct official record for the claimed outcome.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Shorts thumbnails do not appear in the swipe feed but can matter in search, browse, and Shorts-shelf contexts.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Bounded context only.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not generalize beyond search/browse/shelf contexts.

rules.RULE_TEXT: A creator claims Shorts and long-form use separate algorithms/audiences and should not share a channel.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Preserve the conflict with CLM-005; do not resolve by assertion.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not present as settled platform fact -- it is contradicted.

rules.RULE_TEXT: A speaker frames YouTube discovery history as keyword -> attention -> interest -> 'semantic' eras.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Historical narrative framing only.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not present as an official platform timeline.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Semantic matching is interpreted as reducing the value of generic content/subscriber totals relative to specific content for a clearly understood viewer.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Strategic hypothesis for niche specificity.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Not a measured platform rule.

rules.RULE_TEXT: TV friction/lean-back viewing is interpreted as favoring recognizable, show-like, bingeable, sometimes longer videos.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Not a working assumption; participants describe divergent personal behavior.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not treat as universal.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Personality/personal connection is argued to become a stronger differentiator as high-production spectacle becomes easier to imitate.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Creator-strategy interpretation only.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Not a measured platform rule.

rules.RULE_TEXT: A strategist speculates the mature long-form recommender is more sophisticated than the newer Shorts recommender.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Personal judgment, explicitly framed as such by the speaker.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not present as fact.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Compare analytics against similar videos, inspect retention-drop points and like rates, and combine metrics with direct audience feedback.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Sound practice; retention-drop data itself is NOT_AVAILABLE in this corpus.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not fabricate retention-drop values to follow this recommendation.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Do not disable subscriber notifications merely to game recommendations; inspect subscriber-source behavior separately.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Operational guidance.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Not applicable outside notification settings.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Align channels with audiences and brand promises; choose same-channel vs separate-channel formats by audience overlap and creator goals, not a universal rule.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Channel-architecture guidance; explicitly rejects a universal answer.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not force a single answer for every channel.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Find differentiated value and make a consistent promise to a defined audience rather than becoming the Nth interchangeable treatment of a topic.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Directly usable for the new-channel blueprint differentiation section.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Strategic advice, not a guaranteed outcome.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Launch with several linked videos so a viewer can continue through a coherent journey and build multiple watch-history interactions.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Usable for a new-channel launch-cohort experiment category.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Not an experimentally verified rule in this repository.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Develop repeatable formats into recognizable 'shows' supporting multiple episodes, binge paths, and returning-viewer relationships.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Maps to REPEATABLE_WINNER_FAMILY family-health thinking.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Do not maximize every isolated view at the expense of format identity.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Structure scripts with an early direct answer and specific names/dates/places to make passages citation-friendly for AI answers (AEO).
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Do not use as a working assumption for ranking.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Claimed AEO ranking/citation mechanism is not independently supported.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Build linked off-platform profiles so a faceless channel reads as a consistent brand rather than an anonymous content farm.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Do not use as a working assumption for ranking.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Claimed platform trust signal is not established.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Seek specific questions/subjects not already covered well and contribute net-new information rather than generic duplication.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Usable as a content-gap research hypothesis for the new-channel blueprint.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Not established for ranking effects specifically.

rules.RULE_TEXT: Prefer unlisting to deleting an underperforming video, since deletion may remove useful audience-learning data.
rules.SAFE_DOWNSTREAM_USE: Operational hedge.
rules.PROHIBITED_USE: Platform behavior asserted without primary support.

empirical_calibration_evidence.claim: Numbers/specificity in titles increase relative performance.
Opening with context before the twist ('Context Lean') increases relative performance.
Leading a hook with a concrete number increases relative performance.
A counterintuitive/contrarian premise hook increases relative performance.
Calculated-escalation script structure increases relative performance.
Causal consequence-chain ('but/therefore') script structure increases relative performance.
